name: Tasokare Hotel
source:
"Tasokare Hotel" is located between death and life.
All guests who come to this hotel are spirits wandering that thin line...

The protagonist will have to solve the mysteries her partners in the hotel hide.
translation:
“Tasokare Hotel”位于生与死之间。
所有来到这家酒店的客人都精神恍惚地徘徊在一线……

主角必须解开她的伙伴在酒店隐藏的谜团。
